name: pre-cert-certification-window
title: Admit heavy certification only through a PRE_CERT CertificationWindow
description: U-01b. After B-3f3d freezes REVIEW inventory, expensive suites (done_required_validate, validate --full, lattice.config.json doneRequiredCommands) can still start while source or review is not closed. Add a CertificationWindow deep module and a mechanical PRE_CERT gate so heavy certification runs only on a merged, clean, inventory-finalized candidate, then freeze source/test/verifier for that short window. Do not relax freshness, reuse stale receipts, or implement CausalEvidence / ReviewRemediation / AcceptanceAmendment.
